crossRefs.note: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings…
You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.
but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs…
But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of…
Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

translations.web: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.
translations.bsb: After this I looked, and the temple—the tabernacle of the Testimony—was opened in heaven.
translations.kjv: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:
translations.asv: And after these things I saw, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:
